title: BigScoots Review 2026: Plans, Prices, Guarantee and Black Friday
excerpt: BigScoots is managed WordPress hosting from $35 a month, with free migrations and a 45-day refund. It runs no Black Friday sale. Here is who it suits.

meta._yoast_wpseo_metadesc: BigScoots review for 2026: managed WordPress plan prices, the 45-day guarantee, free migrations, its no Black Friday sale policy, pros and cons.
meta.rl_answer: BigScoots is a managed WordPress host from $35 a month. It says it runs no Black Friday sale, and we found no recent independent test.
meta.rl_faqs:
Is BigScoots good? | On paper it is a fair managed WordPress host. We found no recent independent test with numbers.
How much does BigScoots cost? | Essential 75 is $35 a month, or $29.17 a month billed yearly.
Does BigScoots have a Black Friday sale? | BigScoots says on its blog that it does not run Black Friday or Cyber Monday sales.
Does BigScoots offer a money-back guarantee? | It lists a 45-day money-back guarantee.
Does BigScoots migrate sites for free? | It lists free migrations.
